# Allowlist for TestNoUnverifiedModelNameIsPublished (cmd/corral/model_name_gate_test.go).
#
# The static gate scans every tracked text file for a vendor-shaped model
# name (gemini-*, claude-*, gpt-*, o1-*, o3-*, qwen*, llama*, mistral*,
# mixtral*, deepseek*, gemma*, phi-*) and fails on anything not listed here.
#
# Format, one entry per line, pipe-delimited:
#   <name> | <flag> | <reason>
#
# <flag> is one of:
#   ok           the name may appear anywhere.
#   prose-only   the name may appear ONLY in a position that reads as prose
#                (not inside a fenced code block, not immediately after a
#                model-shaped key such as `model:`/`-model `/`"model":`, and
#                not inside a workflow `with:` block). Use this for a name
#                that must be discussed (e.g. explaining it never existed)
#                but must never again be typed as something to run.
#
# <reason> is free text. By convention it starts with one of these honest
# categories, then the evidence:
#   verified-served    — currently confirmed real and served by its provider;
#                         appears where an operator would read it as "use
#                         this". Add the date you checked.
#   historical-record   — names what a PAST run actually used (a recorded
#                         tape, a leaderboard/ledger fixture); not a
#                         recommendation for a new run.
#   test-fixture         — a literal string fed to a parser/router in a _test.go
#                         file to exercise behavior across many name shapes,
#                         some deliberately fake; asserts nothing about
#                         whether the provider serves it.
#   not-a-model          — the match is real text but is not a model name at
#                         all (an actor label, an env-var/input name, a
#                         software/tool name, a scratch path, a generic
#                         family word used descriptively, a Go identifier).
#   NEVER EXISTED         — the name was never served by its provider. Only
#                         ever paired with the `prose-only` flag.
#
# To add a model: verify it against its provider's own model listing (or
# `corral doctor`'s live gate once that lands), then add a line here dated
# with today and the evidence, per docs/design/model-registry.md's "Adding a
# model" section. Do not add a line to make the gate pass without doing that.

# --- prose-only: discussed, must never be typed as a recommendation --------
gemini-3.6-pro | prose-only | NEVER EXISTED — the served >=3.6 line is flash only; the pro line stops at gemini-3.1-pro-preview. Appears only in post-mortem prose (docs/design/model-registry.md's "What went wrong" section, .github/workflows/self-audit.yml's writer-seat comment explaining the two-day/two-hour incident). Must fail this gate the moment it shows up in a code fence, after a `model:`/`-model`/`"model"` key, or in a workflow `with:` value.
